## Key concept: one folder, multiple branches

A Git branch is **not** a separate folder on disk. Your local repository always
lives at one path — something like:

```
~/GitHub/forestsearch/
```

When you switch branches in GitHub Desktop, Git updates the files inside that
single folder to reflect the branch you switched to. Everything always happens
in the same place.

The practical consequence for this review is:

- `dev/cran_submission/review_1/` holds the corrected files **as documentation**
  — it lives inside the repo and is committed to `master`
- The actual package source files (`R/*.R`, `DESCRIPTION`,
  `vignettes/forestsearch.Rmd`) live at the package root level of the same folder
- The `cran-review-1` branch exists so that the corrections to those package
  source files are isolated and reviewable before they reach `master`

You copy files from `dev/cran_submission/review_1/` into their proper package
locations while on the `cran-review-1` branch. GitHub Desktop sees those copies
as the branch's uncommitted changes.

### Practical flow in plain terms

**Step A — while still on `master`:** copy the entire `review_1/` documentation
folder into `dev/cran_submission/` and commit it. This gives you a permanent
record on `master` before any branch work begins.

**Step B — create `cran-review-1` from `master`.** At the moment the branch is
created, the branch and `master` are byte-for-byte identical. The `review_1/`
documentation is already present on the branch because it was committed to
`master` in Step A.

**Step C — while on `cran-review-1`:** copy the corrected source files *upward*
from `dev/cran_submission/review_1/R/` to `R/`, from
`dev/cran_submission/review_1/vignettes/` to `vignettes/`, and
`dev/cran_submission/review_1/DESCRIPTION` to `DESCRIPTION` — all within the
same `~/GitHub/forestsearch/` folder. GitHub Desktop sees those overwrites as
the branch's uncommitted changes.

**Why don't the `review_1/` files appear as branch changes in Step C?**
Because Git already knows about them — they were committed to `master` in Step A,
before the branch was created. From Git's perspective they are unchanged on the
branch. Only the package root files that you overwrite in Step C appear as diffs.

---

## Full local directory picture

After all steps are complete, your local `~/GitHub/forestsearch/` looks like
this (showing only relevant paths):

```
~/GitHub/forestsearch/          ← single working directory, always
│
├── DESCRIPTION                 ← corrected (on cran-review-1 branch)
├── R/
│   ├── bootstrap_dofuture_main.R        ← corrected
│   ├── cox_ahr_cde_wrapper.R            ← corrected
│   ├── subgroup_consistency_helpers.R   ← corrected
│   └── ... (12 more corrected files)
├── vignettes/
│   └── forestsearch.Rmd        ← corrected
│
└── dev/
    └── cran_submission/
        └── review_1/           ← documentation only; committed to master
            ├── cran_review_1_workflow.qmd   ← this document
            ├── cran_review_fixes.qmd
            ├── DESCRIPTION                  ← source of the copy above
            ├── vignettes/
            │   └── forestsearch.Rmd         ← source of the copy above
            └── R/
                ├── bootstrap_dofuture_main.R  ← source of the copy above
                └── ... (14 more)
```

The files in `dev/cran_submission/review_1/` are the **source copies** downloaded
from Claude. The files at the package root are where they must end up for
`R CMD check` to see them. You copy from one location to the other while on the
`cran-review-1` branch.

## Step-by-step workflow

### Step 1 — Download the corrected files from Claude

Download all files from the artifact panel in this conversation. They will land
in your `~/Downloads/` folder (or wherever your browser saves files).

Files to download:

```
DESCRIPTION
forestsearch.Rmd
bootstrap_dofuture_main.R
cox_ahr_cde_wrapper.R
subgroup_consistency_helpers.R
forestsearch_cross_validation.R
generate_aft_dgm_main.R
generate_aft_dgm_helpers_outcome.R
get_fsdata.R
grf_helpers.R
find_k_inter_main.R
plot_sg_results.R
plot_sg_weighted_km.R
render_forestplot.R
sim_aft_gbsg.R
synthetic_data_perturbation.R
truefind_asymptotic.R
cran_review_fixes.qmd
cran_review_1_workflow.qmd    ← this document
```

### Step 2 — Commit the documentation folder to `master`

This step is done **before** creating the branch, because the `review_1/`
documentation folder is a permanent record that belongs on `master` regardless
of any branch activity.

1. Confirm you are on `master` in GitHub Desktop.
2. In Finder, create this folder structure inside your local repo:

   ```
   ~/GitHub/forestsearch/dev/cran_submission/review_1/R/
   ~/GitHub/forestsearch/dev/cran_submission/review_1/vignettes/
   ```

3. Copy files from `~/Downloads/` into `review_1/` as follows:

   | File in `~/Downloads/` | Destination inside `review_1/` |
   |---|---|
   | `cran_review_fixes.qmd` | `cran_review_fixes.qmd` |
   | `cran_review_1_workflow.qmd` | `cran_review_1_workflow.qmd` |
   | `DESCRIPTION` | `DESCRIPTION` |
   | `forestsearch.Rmd` | `vignettes/forestsearch.Rmd` |
   | `bootstrap_dofuture_main.R` | `R/bootstrap_dofuture_main.R` |
   | `cox_ahr_cde_wrapper.R` | `R/cox_ahr_cde_wrapper.R` |
   | `subgroup_consistency_helpers.R` | `R/subgroup_consistency_helpers.R` |
   | `forestsearch_cross_validation.R` | `R/forestsearch_cross_validation.R` |
   | `generate_aft_dgm_main.R` | `R/generate_aft_dgm_main.R` |
   | `generate_aft_dgm_helpers_outcome.R` | `R/generate_aft_dgm_helpers_outcome.R` |
   | `get_fsdata.R` | `R/get_fsdata.R` |
   | `grf_helpers.R` | `R/grf_helpers.R` |
   | `find_k_inter_main.R` | `R/find_k_inter_main.R` |
   | `plot_sg_results.R` | `R/plot_sg_results.R` |
   | `plot_sg_weighted_km.R` | `R/plot_sg_weighted_km.R` |
   | `render_forestplot.R` | `R/render_forestplot.R` |
   | `sim_aft_gbsg.R` | `R/sim_aft_gbsg.R` |
   | `synthetic_data_perturbation.R` | `R/synthetic_data_perturbation.R` |
   | `truefind_asymptotic.R` | `R/truefind_asymptotic.R` |

4. GitHub Desktop will show all these new files as uncommitted changes on
   `master`. Commit them with a message such as:

   ```
   Add dev/cran_submission/review_1 documentation (CRAN review 1 record)
   ```

5. Click **Push origin** to push `master` to GitHub.

At this point `master` has the documentation. The package source files at the
root (`R/*.R`, `DESCRIPTION`, `vignettes/forestsearch.Rmd`) are still the
original pre-review versions.

### Step 3 — Create the `cran-review-1` branch

In GitHub Desktop:

1. Click **Current Branch** (shows `master`) → **New Branch**.
2. Name it `cran-review-1`.
3. Confirm "Based on: `master`" is shown.
4. Click **Create Branch**.

GitHub Desktop switches your working directory to `cran-review-1`. The files on
disk are identical to `master` at this moment — you are now on a clean branch.

### Step 4 — Copy the corrected files to their package locations

Still in Finder, copy from `dev/cran_submission/review_1/` to the package root.
Both source and destination are inside `~/GitHub/forestsearch/`:

| Copy from (`dev/cran_submission/review_1/`) | Copy to (package root) |
|---|---|
| `DESCRIPTION` | `DESCRIPTION` |
| `vignettes/forestsearch.Rmd` | `vignettes/forestsearch.Rmd` |
| `R/bootstrap_dofuture_main.R` | `R/bootstrap_dofuture_main.R` |
| `R/cox_ahr_cde_wrapper.R` | `R/cox_ahr_cde_wrapper.R` |
| `R/subgroup_consistency_helpers.R` | `R/subgroup_consistency_helpers.R` |
| `R/forestsearch_cross_validation.R` | `R/forestsearch_cross_validation.R` |
| `R/generate_aft_dgm_main.R` | `R/generate_aft_dgm_main.R` |
| `R/generate_aft_dgm_helpers_outcome.R` | `R/generate_aft_dgm_helpers_outcome.R` |
| `R/get_fsdata.R` | `R/get_fsdata.R` |
| `R/grf_helpers.R` | `R/grf_helpers.R` |
| `R/find_k_inter_main.R` | `R/find_k_inter_main.R` |
| `R/plot_sg_results.R` | `R/plot_sg_results.R` |
| `R/plot_sg_weighted_km.R` | `R/plot_sg_weighted_km.R` |
| `R/render_forestplot.R` | `R/render_forestplot.R` |
| `R/sim_aft_gbsg.R` | `R/sim_aft_gbsg.R` |
| `R/synthetic_data_perturbation.R` | `R/synthetic_data_perturbation.R` |
| `R/truefind_asymptotic.R` | `R/truefind_asymptotic.R` |

After copying, GitHub Desktop will show the 17 modified files as uncommitted
changes on `cran-review-1`. The files inside `dev/cran_submission/review_1/`
will **not** appear as changes — they were already committed to `master` in
Step 2, so Git considers them unchanged.

### Step 5 — Regenerate documentation in RStudio

With the corrected files now at the package root, open `forestsearch.Rproj` in
RStudio and run:

```r
devtools::document()   # regenerates man/ and NAMESPACE
devtools::load_all()   # load the updated package into the session
```

`devtools::document()` will update `man/*.Rd` files and add four new export
entries to `NAMESPACE` for the functions promoted from `@keywords internal`
to `@export`:

```
export(create_sample_size_table)
export(detect_variable_types)
export(extract_selected_tree_cuts)
export(find_quantile_for_proportion)
```

GitHub Desktop will now also show the updated `man/*.Rd` files and `NAMESPACE`
as additional uncommitted changes on the branch — this is expected and correct.

### Step 6 — Run `R CMD check --as-cran`

```r
devtools::check_built(args = "--as-cran")
```

Expected result: **0 errors | 0 warnings | 1 note**

The one NOTE (`unable to verify current time`) is a local network condition
unrelated to the package and is documented in `cran-comments.md`.

### Step 7 — Win-builder testing

Build the source tarball:

```r
devtools::build()
# produces forestsearch_0.1.0.tar.gz one level above ~/GitHub/forestsearch/
```

Submit at <https://win-builder.r-project.org/> for both **R-devel** and
**R-release**. Results arrive by email within ~30 minutes.

### Step 8 — Commit the branch

Once both the local check and win-builder pass:

1. In GitHub Desktop, confirm the active branch is `cran-review-1`.
2. Review the changed files in the diff pane — you should see the 17 corrected
   source files plus the regenerated `man/*.Rd` files and `NAMESPACE`.
3. Write a commit message:

   ```
   CRAN review 1: fix 8 policy issues (donttest, par, warn, value tags, exports)
   ```

4. Click **Commit to cran-review-1**.
5. Click **Push origin**.

### Step 9 — Merge into `master`

In GitHub Desktop:

1. Click **Current Branch** → switch to `master`.
2. Choose **Branch → Merge into Current Branch**.
3. Select `cran-review-1` and click **Create a merge commit**.
4. Click **Push origin** to push the updated `master` to GitHub.

Optionally tag the merge commit to mark the submission state:

- **Repository → Create Tag**, name it `v0.1.0-cran-r1`.

### Step 10 — Submit to CRAN

Upload the `.tar.gz` tarball built in Step 7 at:

```
https://cran.r-project.org/submit.html
```

Paste the contents of `cran-comments.md` into the submission form's comments
field.

---

## `.gitignore` — no changes needed

`dev/cran_submission/` should **not** be added to `.gitignore`. It is
documentation that belongs in version control for the same reasons the rest of
`dev/` is tracked.

The `dev/` folder is excluded from the built package via `.Rbuildignore`, so
none of this appears on CRAN. Confirm this line is present in `.Rbuildignore`
at the package root:

```
^dev$
```

---

## Conventions for future review rounds

If CRAN responds with a second set of comments, follow the same pattern:

```
dev/cran_submission/
├── review_1/    ← permanent record, never modified after Step 2
└── review_2/    ← new folder: updated .qmd files + only files that change
```

Branch: `cran-review-2`, created from `master` at that point.

---

## Summary

| Step | Action | Tool |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Download corrected files from Claude | Browser |
| 2 | Copy into `dev/cran_submission/review_1/`; commit to `master` | Finder + GitHub Desktop |
| 3 | Create branch `cran-review-1` from `master` | GitHub Desktop |
| 4 | Copy corrected files from `review_1/` to package root | Finder |
| 5 | Regenerate `man/` and `NAMESPACE` | RStudio: `devtools::document()` |
| 6 | Run `R CMD check --as-cran` | RStudio: `devtools::check_built()` |
| 7 | Test on win-builder (R-devel + R-release) | win-builder.r-project.org |
| 8 | Commit changes to `cran-review-1`; push | GitHub Desktop |
| 9 | Merge `cran-review-1` → `master`; push | GitHub Desktop |
| 10 | Submit tarball to CRAN | cran.r-project.org/submit.html |
